# Examplicity

> Interactive educational labs published as single HTML files that work offline and can be adapted by educators and AI tools.

## Developer resources

- [Lab system reference](https://www.examplicity.org/developer): Instructions for adapting labs, creating new activities from examples, design references and offline requirements.
- [Living design guide](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/design-language.html): Visual reference for concept colours, activity controls, working, feedback and completion behavior.
- [Written style contract](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-style-contract.md): Concise adaptation rules for using the canonical shared components without copying one layout.
- [Lab Kit 0.3.0](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-kit/0.3.0/README.md): Shared design components and authoring capabilities. Compatible base-runtime declarations may remain at 0.2.1 while the design/distribution layer uses 0.3.0.
- [Lab Contract reference](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-contract): Embedded guidance for preserving a lab's learning relationship during adaptation.
- [Lab Contract v1 schema](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-contract.schema.json): Machine-readable JSON Schema.
- [Developer index](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/llms.txt): Compact index for lab development tools and artifacts.

## Labs

- [Lab catalogue](https://www.examplicity.org/): Browse the currently published labs.
